title: Professor Nincompoop
author: Jimmy Vee
intro: Professor Nincompoop tells his two biggest fans, Nick and Tess, that he has discovered a brand-new species of animal!
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide

questions.q: Who are Professor Nincompoop's two biggest fans?
questions.clue: They are two children named Nick and Tess.
questions.yes: Nick and Tess are Professor Nincompoop's two biggest fans.

questions.q: What does Professor Nincompoop say he has discovered?
questions.clue: He claims it is a mysterious living creature.
questions.yes: Professor Nincompoop says he has discovered a new kind of animal.

questions.q: Why is the professor so excited about his discovery?

options.text: To get in the Hall of Fame
To win a shiny new bike

questions.clue: His dream is to have his picture in the Professors Hall of Fame.
questions.yes: He wants his discovery to get him into the Professors Hall of Fame.

questions.q: Where does the professor say his discovery began?

options.text: At the bottom of the sea
On top of a snowy mountain

questions.clue: It is a small cupboard inside his own home where clothes hang.
questions.yes: The professor says his research and discovery began in his closet.

questions.q: How do Nick and Tess feel when they first hear the professor's news?
questions.clue: They are his biggest fans and love hearing about his adventures.
questions.yes: Nick and Tess feel excited when they first hear the news.

questions.q: What does the professor claim he can do with 743 animals?
questions.clue: He says he used this skill to talk to animals and ask for clues.
questions.yes: The professor claims he can speak 743 different animal languages.

questions.q: Which animals does the professor say told him where to go?
questions.clue: He names fast spotted cats, monkeys, and prickly animals.
questions.yes: He says cheetahs, baboons, and porcupines told him where to go.

questions.q: What special item does the professor say he always travels with?
questions.clue: It is a bag used for carrying clothes and gear on trips.
questions.yes: The professor says he never travels without his lucky suitcase.

questions.q: What does the professor say surrounded him before he caught the creature?
questions.clue: He says scary monsters with sharp teeth were all around him.
questions.yes: He claims he was surrounded by beastly beasts with fangs.

questions.q: How does the professor claim he captured the massive creature?
questions.clue: He says he used martial arts kicks and moves.
questions.yes: The professor claims he captured the creature using taekwondo.

questions.q: How does the professor say he carried the massive creature home?
questions.clue: It is a small carrier on the front of a two-wheeled bike.
questions.yes: He claims he carried the massive creature home in a bicycle basket.

questions.q: What does the professor bring out to show where the creature is kept?
questions.clue: It is much too small to hold a massive animal.
questions.yes: The professor shows Nick and Tess a tiny box.

questions.q: Why do Nick and Tess start to doubt the professor's story?

options.text: A massive beast cannot fit inside

questions.clue: Think about the size of the box and the size of the creature.
questions.yes: They know a massive creature cannot fit inside a tiny box.

questions.q: What actually comes out when the professor opens the box?
questions.clue: It is not a wild monster at all, just ordinary animals he owns.
questions.yes: The creature turns out to be his own cute little pets.

questions.q: Where do Nick and Tess put the professor's picture at the end?

options.text: On the Pets Wall of Fame
On the front page of the newspaper

questions.clue: They help his dream come true in a way that matches his pets.
questions.yes: Nick and Tess put his picture on the Pets Wall of Fame.
